evidence: paper: |p_z| \le C q^{-D} K^2 \rho_o \psi_o, \qquad |T_z| \le C r q^{-D} K^2 \rho_o \psi_o, \qquad \left|\frac{T_z}{T_\theta}\right| \le C q^{1-D} K = C\,E_{\mathrm{pow}}\,H(2d/X).

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. All three bounds are stated, with Lean's constants explicit where the paper writes an unnamed C. (i) |p_z|: canonicalPressure_partialZ_bound gives |p_z| ≤ |logScaleDerivative| K^2 (1 − f), and logScaleDerivative_bound bounds that prefactor by (2/(1−2h)) q^{−D}; composing them is the paper's first bound with C = 2/(1−2h), and 1 − f = ρ_o ψ_o by tailShape_deficit. (ii) |T_z|: axialBackwardStress_bound has the geometric factor (R^2 − r^2)/(2r) in place of the paper's r, equal to it up to the annulus ratio (on r ≤ R ≤ Λ r it is ≤ ((Λ^2−1)/2) r). (iii) The tilt: terminal_tilt_bound is exactly |T_z|/T_θ ≤ C q^{1−D} K with C = tiltConstant h Λ, and it bundles 0 < T_θ with the quotient bound. The closing equality C q^{1−D} K = C E_pow H(2d/X) is not a standalone Lean declaration: it appears as a calc step inside the proof of released_heat_bound (line 1342), where q^{1−D}·physicalHeat is rewritten as outgoingAmplitude · (Kq)^A/s^A · profile(2(1−t)/s) using 1 − D = A, and is then used only in the ≤ direction to conclude ≤ outgoingAmplitude.
